messages.text: how much will be the shipping charge and tax in india

Shipping shows at checkout once you enter the Indian address — BitFortun units ship on a flat worldwide rate by weight, roughly $30–40 at that size. Indian import duty and GST aren't collected by us; customs bills those on delivery, and I can't quote their figure.

Is India where it'll be running?
